decision.summary: A single temporary offset candidate in U (with coherent N support) begins abruptly at index 595, sustains through 620, and shows only partial recovery thereafter. The return phase is unobserved or ambiguous within the allowed context [560,660]; thus status is uncertain. No other temporary intervals confirmed in this region.

intervals.observation: U-component shows abrupt multi-sample descent from ~−5 to ~−15 MAD starting at index 595, sustained plateau until ~620; N declines modestly (~−3 MAD) during same interval; E remains near zero with minor fluctuations. Return after 620 is incomplete and ambiguous—U recovers only partially by index 625 and does not reach pre-offset level within allowed context (≤660). No opposing return observed before end of context.
